title: Obi embed token claims
description: The claim set a platform's server puts in the short-lived JWT it signs at Obi button-click (PLAN 11.1c, ADR-0014). The Obi backend verifier (backend .../server/token_verifier.py) is the security-authoritative side; this schema mirrors it and a drift test keeps them in lockstep. company_id/company_name/integration are all-three-or-none: a note either carries the full business identity or none of it (a note with none scopes to obi-general-test only).

iss.description: Issuer — must match a trusted platform issuer in config/platforms.json.

sub.description: Stable per-user subject. Only a hash of it is ever traced; the raw value is never persisted or logged.

exp.description: Expiry (epoch seconds). exp - iat must not exceed the platform's configured lifetime_minutes.

company_id.description: Opaque customer id. Audit/future use only — never a scope axis in v1.

integration.description: Platform key (e.g. "mews") — the ONLY business value that maps to knowledge scopes, via platforms.json integrations.
